controlPlaneOverrides.reason: swift-institute/.github#266: the mechanical classifier (root Package.swift present => package class => required status check 'ci / ci-ok') misclassifies this repo. Issues hosts isolated per-reproducer Swift packages by design, so a root Package.swift exists, but its CI emits per-reproducer contexts (swift-issue-<name> / ci-ok, red-by-design while a crash reproduces) and no repo-level 'ci / ci-ok' aggregate ever exists at any head — the package class's required check is therefore permanently unsatisfiable. For this reproducer repo, check redness is the repo's signal, not a defect, so the honest gate is the control class's PR + 1 approval + required-thread-resolution, with no required status checks. Declared override, not a hand-mutation of live ruleset state; convergence applies the control-plane contract to this repo the same way it does for every other control-plane-classified repository.
